display_name.zh: NOAA CH₄ 双来源表面对照器

cards.description: Compare NOAA GML's rendered annual global CH4 growth page with its fixed raw table for a bounded year range, preserving both reported values, uncertainties in ppb, retrieval metadata, response digests, and literal differences.
cards.license: Wrapper BUSL-1.1; NOAA GML source-use page requests fair credit for its measurements and data.
cards.maintainer: Ignition repository maintainers; this field confers no NOAA, Owner, emissions-accounting, or scientific authority.
good_for: Comparing the same requested year range on NOAA GML's rendered CH4 growth page and fixed raw table, including both reported annual increments and uncertainties in ppb.
Detecting literal provider-surface disagreements or missing years while keeping each source retrieval time, HTTP metadata, and response digest attached.
A matched task where both contemporaneous page and raw-table values are required; the one-request raw-only reader does not satisfy this cross-surface task.
not_for: Authenticating NOAA, deciding which surface is correct, explaining a disagreement, validating measurements, or asserting a scientific conclusion.
Estimating methane emissions, attributing sources or sectors, or making causal claims from atmospheric growth values.
Arbitrary URLs, station-level/monthly data, long-term archival, or a reproducible raw-response archive.
only_if: The caller explicitly selects this experimental tool for a bounded, read-only NOAA GML task; no router invokes it automatically.
Network retrieval requires a separate per-invocation --allow-public-network flag and is limited to the fixed HTTPS path on gml.noaa.gov.
counterindicated_when: Public network access is disallowed or the task does not need a near-contemporaneous rendered-page versus raw-table comparison.
Only one raw-table methane value is required; the existing CH4 reader uses one request and retains that lower-request-count scope.
A pinned historical page response, source authentication, methane emissions inventory, source attribution, causal explanation, or independent scientific validation is required.
accepted_input_types: UTF-8 JSON stdin object with schema_version toolbox-noaa-ch4-source-surface-comparison-input-r0 and exactly integer start_year/end_year (1984–2100 inclusive; no more than 50 inclusive years); arbitrary URL fields are rejected.
output_types: For each requested year, provider-reported annual CH4 growth and uncertainty in ppb from the NOAA rendered page and fixed raw table, literal differences, or an explicit missing-year status.
Both fixed source URLs, retrieval timestamps, HTTP status and supplied validators, response SHA-256 digests, request count, and bounded provider-data claim limits.
side_effects: When separately invoked with --allow-public-network, sends exactly two HTTPS GET requests to the fixed NOAA GML rendered CH4 page and raw-table paths; redirects are not followed.
Writes only a bounded JSON result to stdout and errors to stderr; does not write repository files, retain raw response bodies, or transmit a caller-supplied URL.

estimated_cost.basis: The tool makes two fixed public GET requests, one more than the raw-only NOAA CH4 reader. Monetary cost, latency, parser reliability, and service quality have not been comparably measured.

alternatives.reason: Same-gas raw-only lookup minimizes requests when the rendered page is unnecessary.
This candidate has a different species or surface scope and does not replace the requested task contract.
This candidate has a different species or surface scope and does not replace the requested task contract.

cards.fallback: If two public requests are not appropriate, use the raw-only CH4 reader for raw-table tasks or a suitably pinned source snapshot. If either surface cannot be retrieved or parsed, report its explicit status; do not infer a zero, rank the surfaces, or call a cached observation live.

negative_controls: Without --allow-public-network, the CLI sends zero requests and emits no comparison result.
Duplicate JSON keys, Boolean years, extra URL fields, reversed/out-of-range years, and ranges above 50 years are rejected before network access.

Only the two fixed HTTPS paths on gml.noaa.gov are queried; redirects, wrong content types, oversized or slow bodies, wrong-species markers, malformed rows, duplicate/out-of-order years, and invalid uncertainties fail closed.
A live exact match does not establish long-run source agreement, source authenticity, measurement validity, emissions, or causation.
The identity projection keeps this optional candidate non-selectable by automatic routing; this isolated integration changes no router.

router_conditions: Remain excluded unless the exact candidate ID is explicitly allowlisted for a task requiring both same-range NOAA GML rendered-page and raw-table CH4 values.
Require the route profile to include gml.noaa.gov exactly; route planning is not network permission or execution authorization.
Every actual CLI invocation separately requires --allow-public-network and a task-specific decision to make both public requests.
Do not select for raw-table-only methane, CO2 values, emissions inventories, causal analysis, or bibliographic metadata.
cards.claim_ceiling: Provider-reported annual CH4 mole-fraction growth and stated uncertainties from two fixed NOAA GML surfaces at retrieval time, with exact arithmetic differences only. This comparison does not authenticate NOAA, rank surfaces, validate measurements, estimate emissions, attribute sources, or establish a scientific conclusion.
unique_remaining_use_cases: Detect whether NOAA's rendered global CH4 growth page and fixed raw table report the same annual methane increments and uncertainties for a selected range at near-contemporaneous retrieval.

comparison_evidence.scope: This isolated source package retains matched real-task and C1 records for the six NOAA CO2, CH4, and N2O tools. Comparisons are by species, endpoint surface, request count, and output contract only; they do not rank accuracy, reliability, latency, monetary cost, or scientific validity.
findings: The CH4 comparator fetches the rendered page and raw table to report literal differences; the same-gas raw-only lookup remains the one-request choice when only provider raw values are needed.
Other gas comparators use species-specific endpoints and units and cannot replace this task.
Retain by task scope; no surface is ranked as more accurate and no reliability, cost, or scientific-validity claim is made.

deprecation_or_retirement_status.basis: Keep as an optional default-off, two-surface CH4 comparator. C1 evidence supports coexistence with the lower-request-count CH4 raw reader and the distinct CO2 comparator; no incumbent is replaced or retired.

migration_notes: No Current registry entry, default route, permission grant, or existing-tool lifecycle change is made.
The CO2 and CH4 wrappers share a single bounded fetch/parse/compare core; species-specific profiles preserve separate units, endpoints, schemas, and cards.
rollback_steps: Remove this candidate card, CH4 wrapper, CH4 schemas, evidence, docs, tests, and route artifacts from the isolated branch; regenerate identity cards and TOOLBOX.md.
Retain the C1 comparison evidence and source hashes that explain why the raw-only CH4 tool and CO2 comparator remain useful.
Keep the shared core while the existing CO2 wrapper imports it; only restore the CO2 implementation before removing the core.
